correctness.rationale: The coordinate change is exact. At r=1/2 the vector points into the region and at r=2 points inward; h decreases for w>=3 and r>=1/2. Global boundedness on finite intervals and comparison exclude exit; w diverges, h tends 0, r tends 1. The reciprocal derivative (1/h)dot=r-4/w² tends to 1, and (w²)dot=8h yields the three constants. A fresh symbolic checker verifies these identities; numerical runs only support them.
